name: Open Windows with Music
summary: Music drifting out of open windows is the sound of the neighbourhood, and one of the things Zed fights to bring back.
body: The Theme lists open windows with music alongside corner shops and murals as the heart of a lived-in city. Zed names it in his mission: he fights so music can drift from open windows again.

name: Street Tournaments and Late-Night Sparring
summary: Where Zed learned to juggle, dodge and parry: street tournaments and sparring behind the corner shops.
body: Zed learned to fight the way he learned to dance, through rhythm, instinct and community. The tournaments and late-night sparring behind the corner shops taught him combos and defence long before the Rust arrived.
